title: Q-ROOT-repeated-failure: repeated-failure keeps recurring: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure
**Status:** closed

Root cause class `repeated-failure` recurred on 2 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a loop failed the same way again and no change altered the approach
Guard: `grep:foundation/failure_audit.py::def _mode`
Remedy: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
Symptoms seen:
- temporal:e5ddf8e610: ledger:executor:pr-outcome pr-outcome: 1 failures in a row, 5 in the last 3 days against 0 in the 8 before
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T19:11:36Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
